name: @sleepymug/dsh-tau-box
description: What dsh-tau's tau service puts in each box: the tau command, whose runs go to dsh-tau as the box's, and the tau backend's half that sets a run's box up and packs its result; and the wire dsh-tau and it share

scripts.test: node -e "for (const path of ['lib', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b && node --test "lib/**/*.test.js"
